blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The defense lawyers of Vice President Sara Duterte will present on Tuesday, the city assessor of Island Garden City of Samal as its second witness. Samal City Assessor Engr. John Kenneth Enumerables is anticipated to testify on the property linked to Duterte and her husband, Atty. Manases Carpio. This, as the defense takes its turn to debunk the prosecution’s accusation that Duterte failed to declare or wrongfully declared a certain Samal property in her statement of assets, liabilities and net worth.
